reviews.text: I really appreciate Dr. Rajabi and the whole clinic team. Dr. Rajabi is so kind and professional, and I really appreciate how carefully he listens and takes the time to make the right diagnosis. Everyone on the team is also so friendly and welcoming. It’s always nice to be treated with such care and kindness. Thank you all for being so wonderful! ❤️
My visit was very calm, professional and both the doctor and front staffs are friendly and quick to respond

We had issues with our boxer TROUBLE  that ended up being legendary issues. rare situation however Dr Floca dealt with everything with Calmness and a reassurance that we crave these days and took care of our boy always offering 3 or 4 choices.

Considering the rareness of the situation and the surprise Trouble had in store for us, i wanted to thank the whole staff, DR, technicians and everyone else working there that were so kind and helpful during that difficult 3 month stretch.

Thankfully, all's well that ends well....

I'm giving one star for customer service.
I called several times to make an appointment. No answer.
After several attempts, I was asked to wait a moment, and after 15 minutes, the line was hung up.
Another attempt, and they hung up immediately!

I have been bringing my cat here since he was 6 weeks old- over two years. I found him as a stray kitten and I’d never had a cat before. They have been so helpful and kind for the last two years, always willing to answer my calls if I have questions or concerns. They take their time to explain things and really listen. Big recommend!

All the staff members were amazing 💖 I'm definitely going back for my dog's follow ups. This is by far the best service we've ever had compared to other vets. They really made sure to answer all of my questions and took their time to evaluate her properly.

Am so very grateful we eventually landed in this wonderful veterinarian clinic.  Dr, Rajabi was exactly the kind, compassionate, gently informative presence we needed as we faced painful decision-making at the end of our beloved cat's life.  Dr, Rajabi is very experienced and knowledgeable, but also big-hearted, a human being who knows how to be with both animals and humans who are suffering.  It’s a rare gift and was deeply appreciated.

But it’s not just him.  Every single person working at this clinic was warm, welcoming, authentic, empathetic.  It meant the world to us.

Could not recommend these folks more highly.  Will be telling everyone about them.

I've been going to this veterinary clinic for over 10 years: first for my dog, and then, after his passing at the venerable age of 17, for my cat.

What I appreciate most about this clinic is the way we and our animals are treated. Of course, the quality of care and services is impeccable, but what truly sets this clinic apart is the empathy and compassion of the professionals who work there. They take the time to explain everything during the consultation and answer our questions, and they do the same after treatment. This makes all the difference when we receive bad news, for example, about our pet.
For all these reasons, I recommend this clinic without hesitation!
All my dogs have been treated at this clinic and all the veterinarians who have treated my dogs have been wonderful and have been able to create a rapport with us and our animals.
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.
Quick appointment, reasonable price, honest and attentive vet! Thank you for taking care of Paco.

I wrote to request an appointment, but received no response. I called, and when the person answered, they asked me to stay on the line. After a 15-minute wait, they hung up on me. Nothing more to add...
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.

This is just a terrible clinic. We went there because our cat had lost weight and was losing his fur. We went in for an exam, and the vet said we needed to run some tests, and then he would tell us what was wrong with the cat and what to do next. In the end, we had the tests done and paid $500, but it’s been a week and a half now and the vet still hasn’t contacted us. I’ve repeatedly the clinic asking what’s wrong with the cat. I want to speak with the vet, but they just tell me to wait—that the vet will contact me. This is simply the worst service imaginable.
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.

They are amazing :) Not only is the vet competent and compassionate, but the entire staff is incredibly kind and welcoming. I had to wait a little during my lunch break and mentioned I was hungry, and the receptionist offered me a granola bar and a bubbly water. Such a thoughtful gesture. They truly care about their patients and their humans too ❤️ We would never change vets for our 3 cats that we love so much.
Dr. A. Rajabi is excellent. He is always attentive, gentle, and very kind; it's clear he truly loves animals. He always takes the time to answer questions thoroughly. Thank you!
Amazing and honest veterinary clinic, thank you for taking such good care of my cat Mimi and for the dental cleaning!! I highly recommend them!

A veterinary clinic I highly recommend. The reception staff are courteous and friendly. Dr. Rajabi, the veterinarian, is kind, attentive, and very professional. There's no pressure to provide quality care. My Dobby is in good hands! Thank you for being there for our furry friends!
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.
Excellent service, professional and attentive staff

Absolutely terrible vet, unprofessional and rude staff. Place smells of urine, they tried to overcharge me when it was time to pay, when I pointed out the mistake they gave me attitude and eventually removed the charge, no apology.
A great place to take your pet. The veterinarians are very careful and care about our pets' well-being.
Excellent customer service. The staff and doctors are very friendly and knowledgeable. Great vet clinic for superb care of your cat or dog
I've been going to this clinic for 14 years for my cat and dog. The staff and Dr. Liebard are wonderful people, very attentive and, above all, reassuring.
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.

We all know the saying "the best...":

"My hairdresser is the best," "My dentist is the best"... Well, in this case, my veterinarian is the best.

I have complete confidence in the staff at this veterinary clinic who, in addition to their professionalism, are dedicated individuals. Mimo and my late dog Puchi were treated at this clinic, and the service is always impeccable.

They listen to concerns and needs. Besides working wonders to see my dog ​​urgently when he was sick, they were incredibly helpful when I needed to prepare the necessary paperwork for him during a three-week trip abroad. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
They accept new clients quickly! I called and the next day I brought my puppy in for vaccinations. The vet is very friendly, very humane, and good with dogs :)
Great service and kind staff

Dr. Liebart is very good,  cares,  love animals .I  use to feel in confidence for my babies. but since 3 years ,
I HAVE BEEN GOING THERE FOR MORE THAN 15 YEARS.
Things started to change . Im feeling not welcome from the receptionists . They are rude , impolite never smile . Even I got insulted because I asked a question. Plus u call to speak to the Dr. They don't want to give him the message to call back . They answer no no no.
They are liars and not polite  they hang up the phone on me more than 3 times.the lady makes you feel she is the Dr's wife jealous for him. And the rude guy insultes me he gives himself the right to be rude. He says to me because I'm his son. So when family gets involve service quality becomes 0.
I drive from far for Dr. Liebart.  He was so good with big ❤️ heart. But from the negative vibes in his clinic he is changing .They don't give a rdzv.(appointment)
Than they call speaking to me with disrespect on the phone saying I didn't go for my appointment. I tell her you never give me one . She is a liar impolite secretary.  Her and the son. Too bad I can't be going getting disrespected get myself put in position where i have to justify myself to the Dr.  Liebart  . because of them I don't feel that my animals are safe . Those 2 could hurt my animals because they don't like me.  I will be paying 2000.00 for my cat to die plus I get insulted and treated bad enough.
Dr  medere and Dr. Liebart are very good .
But they will be losing customers because of them. This is addressed to Dr. Liebart.
before I use to handle and shut up about your secretary s rudness now you have 2 rude people working for you. You are a great person and a doctor ❤️.  But enough is enough.  Plus I dont trust the guy at front desk , I feel he killed my cat  Prince at night . I'm sorry I don't trust him. Thank you so much.
I give 5 stars to Dr. Liebart 5stars Dr. Medere .
0 star to the guy and the lady at front desk .

Wow! The surgery for a 'tumor' performed by Dr. Liébart on my 12-year-old dog's eyelid was impeccable: a huge relief and, what's more, it looked like beautiful cosmetic surgery. His approach and follow-up are very professional and empathetic. Mia was treated with great respect. 100% confidence. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

I have been taking my cats there for the past decade (almost). Wonderful staff and their empathetic doctors are very attentive. Over the years, I have referred two of my friends and a family member to Clinique Pillet. No complaints, we all agree that they're just great.
Very friendly staff! The doctor has the best recommendations.
Excellent clinic. Dr. Liébart treats animals with the utmost respect. He takes the time to clearly explain the situation and outline the various treatment options available for our pet.
Thank you for taking the time to write to us.
We've been going to this clinic for several years. We appreciate the quality of care our cats receive, the professionalism of the veterinarians, and the warm welcome from the entire team.
